item.description: Hong Kong police have arrested a van driver on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm after he knocked down a 73-year-old woman at a pedestrian crossing in Pok Fu Lam. The woman, surnamed Fong, was unconscious when taken to Queen Mary Hospital for emergency treatment. The 36-year-old driver, surnamed Ho, had reportedly just finished unloading goods at Chi Fu Landmark’s loading bay and was turning right onto Chi Fu Road around 8am on Monday when Fong attempted to cross in...

item.description: A fire raged through a four-storey shophouse on Thailand’s resort island of Phuket early on Monday, killing 11 people and injuring 16, police said. The blaze began around 3.30am at a commercial building housing a motorcycle rental shop and residences, a police officer from Phuket’s Patong community said. “Firefighters took two hours to get the fire under control and found 11 people dead”, including Thais and Myanmar nationals, he said. item.title: Thai police probe transformer blast after Phuket shophouse fire kills 11

item.dc:creator: Kyodo
item.description: Artificial intelligence-based typhoon track forecasts in Japan are outperforming conventional physics-based models, with AI accurately projecting early on the path that last month’s Typhoon Champi would ultimately take. Private weather service Weathernews Inc has been using AI forecasts, while Japan’s weather agency is pursuing research and development towards their use. item.dc:creator: Gabriel Dominguez
item.description: Chinese military aircraft have been spotted increasing activity in the skies around Japan’s southwestern islands amid an aircraft carrier fleet operation in the western Pacific and persistent tension between the two nations. Japan scrambled fighter jets against Chinese military aircraft 94 times in October, the highest monthly figure in nearly five years, according to preliminary figures released by Japan’s Joint Staff late last week. item.description: Fishermen along Thailand’s stretch of the Mekong River have reported an outbreak of “zombie fish” with blisters, strange growths and discoloured fins. The sightings have raised fears that mining upstream is polluting the waterway with arsenic and other heavy metals. Photographs of the affected species of catfish, known locally as pla khae, were shared on social media on Saturday by Thai environmental activist Aombun Thipsuna. Their unusual appearance had led some villagers to call them “zombie...

item.dc:creator: Aidan Jones
item.description: Thailand and Cambodia are seeking to control the global diplomacy narrative over their border dispute as US President Donald Trump heads to Southeast Asia’s top annual summit. item.description: Malaysian police have arrested a 28-year-old man in Sarawak on suspicion of impregnating a girl, 12, who was still in primary school. The case has reignited debate over child marriage in Malaysia, as the girl’s mother reportedly told the school that she wanted her daughter to marry the baby’s father. Police are investigating the man for statutory rape, an offence that carries a maximum penalty of up to 20 years in prison and caning under the country’s penal code.
